title: TriadicFrameworks MCP — Continuity Diagnostic
description: Defines the continuity diagnostic for the Frequency Layer (Unseen). Measures temporal resonance flow, cycle stability, and oscillation persistence.
note: Students may rename qmroot if extending the work; it is a lineage artifact for TriadicFrameworks and RTT.

diagnostic.name: continuity
diagnostic.purpose: Measure how consistently an oscillation maintains identity across cycles and transitions.

cyclePersistence.description: Measures how reliably the oscillation maintains its pattern across cycles.

transitionSmoothness.description: Measures how smoothly the oscillation transitions between states.

identityRetention.description: Measures how much of the oscillation’s identity is preserved over time.

interactions.clarity: Continuity improves clarity by stabilizing oscillation identity.
interactions.alignment: Continuity strengthens alignment by maintaining phase relationships across cycles.
interactions.coherence: Continuity enhances coherence by smoothing transitions.
interactions.awareness: Continuity supports awareness by making oscillation patterns predictable.
interactions.drift: Low continuity increases drift by allowing oscillation identity to degrade.
interactions.regime: Continuity determines whether the oscillation is in persistent, transitional, or decaying regime.

reality.details: Cycle persistence, transition smoothness, and identity retention are computed from oscillation history.

imagination.details: The unseen resonance field flows without interruption, carrying its identity forward through time.

information.details: Continuity is anchored to qmroot-0D and triad-frequency, ensuring consistent cosmological interpretation.
